speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.he: You come armed to her hearth? Then let us see what you're made of.
Sit. Rest. I'll mend while you bleed.
The fire is banked no longer!
Come, little embers. We have guests.
Well struck. Keep the fire for her.
You let her hearth go cold. I've come to see you out.
Lie there and think on it. She remembers you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.an: Iron rings true or it breaks. Which are you?
Strike, then. My skin is his anvil.
Up from the deep, all of you!
A true blow. Take his iron, smith's child.
You turned from the Father. He sent me to test the break.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.de: The tide has come in for you.
The sea gives back what it took.
You left her shore. The tide always finds the shore.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.gr: Prey that walks in on its own feet. How rare.
You won't see me again until it's too late.
You left his wood. Now you're in it.
Brought down. That's the way of the wild.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.la: A light for the living, or a light for your grave?
A lantern for each of you.
The lamp goes out. Keep yours lit.
You walked out of his light. The dark followed you.
Rest. The lamp will find you when you wake.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.cr: Kneel, or be judged in the sun's full light.
The crown is guarded. Strike me from behind, if you dare.
To arms! The crown is assailed!
You have earned the sun's notice.
Oath-breaker. The Sun does not forget a deserter.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.as: Shh. You weren't supposed to find this place.
Can you see me now? No?
Which of us is real, I wonder?
You told her secrets to the light. I've come about that.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.patron_champion.tr: You would raise a hand in the Truth's own house? Then be weighed.
Your charms are lies. I strip them.
Judgement comes. Stand together, or fall alone.
The Truth does not need me to stand.
Apostate. The Truth sends one witness for you.
